notes: Sleep in the garage (original scene 24: factory 0xa327e, create 0x2e47c, run 0x2e3ad, destroy 0x2e39d). It draws nothing, so the screen is black, and plays no music.
It plays sys entry 43 ("sleep") and waits the frame rate times four (seconds); A or START (0xdf310, the port's confirm) cuts the wait short. The sound stops as the screen closes.

Then the night passes: the calendar day (the save's + 0x9cc, bits 20-29, the HUD's DAY) moves on and wraps after days_in_cycle; as it wraps, a cleared game counts a lap (+ 0x604c). The days slept (+ 0x5ffc) count up to total_days_max. The town map's spin payments (+ 0x113c8) start again.
The original also redraws the rival teams' contest entries for the new day (0x6cf5a) and picks ten numbers into + 0xc28 (0x2a540); the port has neither table yet.
Result 0 leads to the garage (scene 13), whose cursor comes back to the hangar.
